task.name: pick_ball_put_drawer
task.description: Use the right arm to pick up the table tennis ball and place it in the open drawer.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the table tennis ball.
2. Grasp the table tennis ball with the right arm.
3. Move the right arm to align with the open drawer.
4. Release the gripper to place the table tennis ball into the open drawer.
